definitions.gloss: taking office, inauguration, assuming a post
definitions.explanation: The formal act of assuming an official position or role, such as president, CEO, or other leadership position.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{社長|しゃちょう}が{就任|しゅうにん}した。
{就任|しゅうにん}のあいさつで{今後|こんご}の{方針|ほうしん}を{述|の}べた。
examples.english: In the inauguration speech, the future policy was laid out.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{史上|しじょう}{最年少|さいねんしょう}で{大臣|だいじん}に{就任|しゅうにん}した。
examples.english: She became the youngest minister in history.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
The pattern is [position]に{就任|しゅうにん}する (to assume the position of ...). The position is marked with に.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社長|しゃちょう}に{就任|しゅうにん}する — to become president
- {大臣|だいじん}に{就任|しゅうにん}する — to become minister
- {就任|しゅうにん}{演説|えんぜつ} — inauguration speech
- {就任|しゅうにん}あいさつ — inauguration greeting
- {就任|しゅうにん}{式|しき} — inauguration ceremony

SIMILAR WORDS:
{着任|ちゃくにん} means arriving at and starting a new post, especially when relocation is involved. {赴任|ふにん} means going to take up a new post at a different location. {就任|しゅうにん} focuses on the formal assumption of the position itself. The opposite is {辞任|じにん} (resignation).
